framework.name: CompPlus Core Compliance Pack
framework.description: Plain-English shared management controls used once across ISO 27001, ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 42001 and UK GDPR.

controls.name: Define the management-system scope
controls.description: Define the organisation, services, locations, systems, dependencies and exclusions covered by the management system.

controls.name: Assign roles and responsibilities
controls.description: Assign accountable owners, responsibilities, authority and deputies for critical compliance roles.

controls.name: Control documents and records
controls.description: Create, approve, version, protect, retain and dispose of controlled information.

controls.name: Manage risks and opportunities
controls.description: Identify, assess, treat, accept, monitor and review risks and opportunities consistently.

controls.name: Set objectives and monitor performance
controls.description: Set measurable objectives, assign owners and review performance against targets.

controls.name: Maintain competence and awareness
controls.description: Identify competence needs, provide training and keep evidence of awareness and capability.

controls.name: Manage suppliers
controls.description: Assess, approve, contract with and monitor suppliers according to their risk and importance.

controls.name: Manage incidents
controls.description: Prepare for, report, assess, contain, recover from and learn from incidents.

controls.name: Correct nonconformities
controls.description: Contain problems, analyse root causes, complete corrective actions and verify effectiveness.

controls.name: Maintain applicable obligations
controls.description: Identify, assign, review and evidence legal, regulatory, contractual and standards obligations.

controls.name: Perform internal audits
controls.description: Plan independent audits based on importance, risk, change and previous results.

controls.name: Perform management reviews
controls.description: Senior management reviews performance, risks, changes, resources and improvement decisions.

measure.name: Management-system scope is defined and approved
measure.description: Keep the scope accurate after organisational, service, location or technology changes.

task.name: Review and approve the management-system scope
task.description: Confirm included services, locations, systems, dependencies and any justified exclusions.

measure.name: Compliance roles and authority are assigned
measure.description: Maintain named owners and deputies for the responsibilities required by selected packs.

task.name: Confirm compliance owners and deputies
task.description: Review the proposed roles, assign named people and confirm their authority.

measure.name: Documents and records are controlled
measure.description: Apply approval, version, access, retention and disposal rules to controlled information.

task.name: Confirm document-control arrangements
task.description: Confirm storage, approval, versioning, retention and disposal arrangements.

measure.name: Risks and opportunities are assessed and treated
measure.description: Use one repeatable method to score, treat, accept and review risks.

task.name: Complete the initial risk assessment
task.description: Confirm risk criteria, identify priority risks and assign treatment owners.

evidence.name: Completed risk assessment or risk register export

measure.name: Objectives and performance indicators are monitored
measure.description: Maintain measurable objectives, owners, deadlines, results and actions.

task.name: Confirm objectives, targets and owners
task.description: Review starter objectives, remove irrelevant entries and add business-specific objectives.

evidence.name: Current objectives and KPI review record

measure.name: Required competence and awareness are maintained
measure.description: Identify role-based competence, deliver induction and refresher training and retain records.

task.name: Confirm the training plan and competence matrix
task.description: Identify required training by role and assign completion dates.

measure.name: Suppliers are assessed and monitored
measure.description: Classify suppliers, perform due diligence, record obligations and review performance.

task.name: Complete the critical supplier register
task.description: Add suppliers that process data or support important services and assign review frequency.

evidence.name: Supplier register and one completed supplier assessment

measure.name: Incidents are reported, managed and reviewed
measure.description: Maintain contacts, severity rules, response steps, communications and lessons learned.

task.name: Confirm and test the incident-management plan
task.description: Confirm contacts and escalation rules, then record a tabletop or practical test.

measure.name: Nonconformities receive effective corrective action
measure.description: Contain issues, identify root cause, implement action and verify effectiveness.

task.name: Confirm the corrective-action workflow
task.description: Confirm reporting, root-cause, approval, deadline and effectiveness-review requirements.

evidence.name: Example corrective-action record or blank approved form

document.title: Legal, Regulatory and Contractual Requirements Register

measure.name: Applicable obligations are identified and reviewed
measure.description: Maintain legal, regulatory, contractual and standards requirements with owners and evidence.

task.name: Confirm applicable legal and contractual obligations
task.description: Review starter entries and add sector, licence, customer and contract-specific obligations.

evidence.name: Reviewed legal and contractual requirements register

measure.name: Internal audits are planned and completed
measure.description: Audit the management system according to risk, importance, change and previous results.

task.name: Confirm the internal audit programme
task.description: Set audit scope, dates and independent auditors for the current cycle.

measure.name: Senior management reviews the management system
measure.description: Review changes, objectives, risks, incidents, audits, suppliers, resources and improvement.

task.name: Hold and approve the management review
task.description: Review the pre-filled agenda, record decisions and assign actions with deadlines.
